Gaijin Trade is a platform for trading various in-game items between players. Sellers and buyers determine supply and demand, the prices of goods. Goods themselves can even run out.

Payments on the Market are made with a special in-game currency – Gaijin Coins. Gaijin Coins can be purchased for roubles, dollars and other currencies, or earned on the Market itself by selling items earned in the game to other players.
